label: Review card
textSource: content/reviews/google-business-reviews.csv, a manual export from the Google Business Profile dashboard
photoSource: real photo of that reviewer's dog if one exists in content/inbox/ or content/done/, otherwise a branded background alone
builtBy: scripts/slide-pipeline.js compositing the review text onto a branded background
automatable: fully once the export file exists
humanStep: export reviews from the Google Business Profile dashboard as CSV, save to content/reviews/google-business-reviews.csv, repeat monthly to keep it fresh. Google does not currently offer a live API pull for a business this size, so this is a real recurring manual step, not a one-time setup.
